own_solution.law: For normal incidence, d sin(theta) = m lambda. The separation is arcsin(2 × 650/4000) − arcsin(2 × 450/4000), expressed in degrees.
assumptions: The stated wavelengths and slit spacing apply to the usual ideal transmission-grating model.
Both second-order maxima are on the same side of the central beam.

defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: T9433 and T8CA3 replace the explicit 560 nm value in their respective counterparts T30F6 and TFEEC with 'a certain wavelength', violating the stated requirement that quantity variants retain the same number and unit.

notes: The base problem and every individual rendered physics problem have unique answers; the invalid verdict concerns the required matching of sentence variants. Replacing the current shorter wavelength gives arcsin(0.325) − arcsin(0.280). Earlier measurements and illumination of the separate spectrometer do not affect the present grating beam. Screen distance enters the spot-position relation x = L tan(theta), but cancels when obtaining angular separation. Both screen sentences retain 2.5 m, and all explicit numerical wavelength variants retain 560 nm.
